findings.title: English restore after an in-word BackSpace commits the resynced Telex keys, not the typed keys: letters lost or reordered
findings.scenario: Preedit/surrounding/hold, any prev: keys `u s e r n BackSpace space` -> commits `uer ` (expected `user `); `l i f e n BS space` -> `lief ` (expected `life `); `n o s e n BS space` -> `noes `; `u s e n BS space` -> `ues ` (expected `use `); `t h e space c u r s o r u BS space` -> `the cuor ` (expected `the cursor `); `m o r e n BS space` -> `moẻ ` (expected `more `, the Vietnamese-looking text is kept because the resynced keys `moer` are not in en.txt).
findings.evidence: pop_letter (lib.rs:282) calls resync_raw, which rewrites `raw` as canonical keys (letters, then the tone key last, the overridden tone keys dropped). finish (lib.rs:374-402) uses `self.raw` both as the en.txt lookup key and as the restored text. Probe p5probe `bs` over en.txt: 203 of the 1,099 words end differently after `<word><letter>BackSpace` than when typed straight (615 cases with prev Unknown), e.g. user, use, life, more, nose, those, cursor, sure, pure, rise. Fix: keep the keys actually typed per letter (or a `typed` string trimmed by the keys of the removed letter) for restore and lookup, or skip the restore when raw was resynced and its text differs from the keys typed. Add a word_end test for `usern<`.

findings.title: Unaccented Vietnamese words keep last = En, so an overlap Vietnamese word several words after one English word turns English
findings.scenario: Preedit/surrounding/hold, fresh field: `guiwr email cho anh max ` -> `gửi email cho anh max ` (expected `gửi email cho anh mã `); `file cho anh cars nhaf ` -> `file cho anh cars nhà ` (expected `cá`); `... cho anh lats nuwax ` -> `lats nữa` (expected `lát nữa`).
findings.evidence: `email`/`file` go Raw -> shown_lang En; `cho`, `anh` have text == raw and are not in en_plain, so finish returns `prev` (lib.rs:385-388, D7), keeping En; `max`/`cars`/`lats` are en.txt keys with vi.txt text, and prev == En selects the raw keys. Reproduced with p5probe `type` in all three edit modes. D7 accepted this for words that are also English (`to`, `in`, `can`), but `cho`/`anh` are not English at all. Fix: an unchanged word that is in vi.txt and not in a broader English list (the full wamerican set, not only the engine-changed en.txt) sets Lang::Vi; or let the En run expire after one unchanged non-English word.

findings.title: Deleting the previous word with BackSpace keeps its language, so the next overlap word follows a word no longer in the field
findings.scenario: Fresh field (preedit/surrounding/hold): `user space`, then BackSpace x5 (field empty), then `bets space` -> `bets ` (expected `bét `: with no previous word AC-3 gives Vietnamese, as typing `bets ` in a fresh field does). The same happens after `email ` + BackSpace x6 then `max ` -> `max` instead of `mã`.
findings.evidence: A BackSpace with an empty composer goes to the `_ =>` arm (ime.rs:459): end_word returns early on an empty composer and `last` (set at ime.rs:205) is never touched; no other path resets it while the focus stays. Probe: `user <<<<<bets ` -> `bets `. Fix: set `ctx.last = Lang::Unknown` when a BackSpace (or Delete) reaches the client with an empty composer. That is cheap and conservative: the next overlap word falls back to Vietnamese, the AC-3 default.

findings.title: English words in en.txt that end in an undo-by-repeat commit the shortened text, even after an English word
findings.scenario: Any edit mode: `the pass ` -> `the pas `; `less ` -> `les `; `miss ` -> `mis `; `boss ` -> `bos `; `guess ` -> `gues `; `kiss ` -> `kis `; `loss ` -> `los ` (expected the keys typed; all seven are in en.txt).
findings.evidence: An undo by repeat puts the composer in Mode::Undone; finish returns the shown text for any non-Viet mode (lib.rs:382-383) and never checks en.txt (D8 counts 245 of the 1,099 en.txt words, left open). AC-2's goal (English words in the list come out as typed) fails for very common words. The reason D8 gives for leaving it (`ass` meant to give `as`) is weaker now that `as` is decided as an overlap word at word end. Fix: in finish, for Mode::Undone after a tone-key undo, when `raw` is in en.txt and the shown text is ASCII-only, return the raw keys with Lang::En. User decision needed per D8.
